entries.zh: 她把润肤软膏装进了药袋。

entries.en: The camping ground reopened after the flood.
entries.zh: 洪水过后，营地重新开放了。

entries.en: The diagram highlighted the canalis cervicis uteri.
entries.zh: 示意图重点标出了子宫颈管。

entries.en: The model showed the canalis inguinalis clearly.
entries.zh: 模型清楚地展示了腹股沟管。

entries.en: The scan revealed narrowing of the canalis vertebralis.
entries.zh: 扫描显示椎管变窄了。

entries.en: The child carried a shiny candied apple.
entries.zh: 孩子拿着一个亮晶晶的苹果蜜饯。

entries.en: She chopped candied citrus peel for the cake.
entries.zh: 她为蛋糕切碎了柑橘皮蜜饯。

entries.en: The stall sold candied fruit in paper bags.
entries.zh: 摊位出售纸袋装的蜜饯水果。

entries.en: Wax dripped onto the brass candle holder.
entries.zh: 蜡滴到了黄铜蜡烛台上。

entries.meaningZh: 年轻女志愿护士助手〔美式用语〕
entries.en: The young candy striper delivered flowers to her ward.
entries.zh: 那位年轻的女志愿护士助手把鲜花送进了她所在的病房。
